definitions.short: to entwine , i.e. shut in (for formation, protection or restraint)
definitions.full: H7753. suk I. [ שׂוּךְ ] verb hedge or fence up, about (= II. סוּךְ , q. v.); — Qal Perfect 2masculine singular דַעֲדוֺ שַׂכְתָּ Job 1:10 hast fenced him about (protectingly); Participle שָׂךְ Hosea 2:8 will hedge up (obstruct) thy way (accusative). p. 692.
